target: fire_positive on target_date = feature_date + one UTC day
prediction_time_assumption: Completed feature UTC day plus data availability; retrospective ERA5-Land inputs do not simulate operational forecast latency.

feature_date.definition: Date represented by all predictor values.

target_date.definition: Following day used to create the fire label.

split.definition: Chronological train, validation or test partition.

park_area_fraction.definition: Fraction of the ERA5 cell covered by the park.

relative_humidity_mean_pct.definition: Daily mean relative humidity derived from temperature and dew point.

precipitation_sum_mm.definition: ERA5-Land daily accumulation ending at 00 UTC on the following day.

precipitation_3d_mm.definition: Rolling three-day precipitation sum ending on feature_date.

wind_speed_mean_ms.definition: Daily mean 10 m wind speed derived from u10 and v10.

wind_speed_max_ms.definition: Daily maximum derived 10 m wind speed.

day_of_year_sin.definition: Sine encoding of seasonal day of year.

day_of_year_cos.definition: Cosine encoding of seasonal day of year.

dem_valid_pixel_count.definition: Valid park-clipped SRTM pixels in the cell.

elevation_mean_m.definition: Mean SRTM elevation within the park portion of the cell.

elevation_min_m.definition: Minimum SRTM elevation within the park portion of the cell.

elevation_max_m.definition: Maximum SRTM elevation within the park portion of the cell.

slope_mean_deg.definition: Mean terrain slope derived from SRTM.

aspect_mean_deg.definition: Circular mean downslope aspect, clockwise from north.

aspect_sin.definition: Sine component of mean terrain aspect for modelling.

aspect_cos.definition: Cosine component of mean terrain aspect for modelling.

fire_detection_count_raw.definition: All retained FIRMS detections in the target cell/day.

prescribed_burn_detection_count.definition: FIRMS detections overlapping a dated NPWS prescribed-burn polygon.

eligible_fire_detection_count.definition: FIRMS detections remaining after the prescribed-burn check.

fire_positive.definition: 1 when at least one eligible FIRMS detection occurs on target_date.

fire_today.definition: Eligible satellite detection in the same park cell on feature_date.

fire_neighbour_today.definition: Eligible detection on feature_date in any of eight neighbours from the original 52-cell panel.

fire_days_last_7.definition: Count of eligible detection days in the seven-day causal window ending on feature_date, 0 to 7.

days_since_rain_5mm.definition: Days since daily precipitation at least 5 mm; capped at 120; initial prior dry history is unknown.

rain_history_days.definition: Number of observed rain days available including the initial 30 June 2019 rainfall day.

precipitation_7d_mm.definition: Causal 7-day rainfall sum ending on feature_date; partial history at the panel start.

precipitation_30d_mm.definition: Causal 30-day rainfall sum ending on feature_date; partial history at the panel start.

precipitation_90d_mm.definition: Causal 90-day rainfall sum ending on feature_date; partial history at the panel start.

decision_rule: Highest validation precision subject to recall >=0.80. Preserve model-specific metadata threshold.
interpretation: Raw ranking score for satellite active-fire detection, including continuing fire; not calibrated ignition probability.
display: Percentage score = 100 * raw score; threshold percentages use the same conversion. Labels and metric calculations retain their original scale.
unobserved_factors: Human ignition and suppression activities are not explicit inputs; low scores do not establish safety.
